book: Thomas Erastus's 1589 Latin treatise on excommunication, in one volume: the Explicatio (75 numbered theses with an appendix), the Confirmatio in six books with chapters, a collection of letters from theologians with a German-text interpretation, and reader notes, errata and an index.
